output.reason: The only evidence, [ev-bd329a64ec5d], is a one-line highlight saying the Image Automation APIs reached general availability. It does not name an API version, either v1 or v1beta2, and does not say whether earlier versions are deprecated, removed or affected in any other way. The rest of the section does not add this either. The proposed exposure lists six gvk-in-use leaves with version literals that the evidence never states, and it treats any use of the APIs, including the new GA version, as exposure without saying what those environments are exposed to. To decide the exposure, we need upstream text naming the version that became GA and saying what happens to existing beta-version usage.
